files.content:
# event-feed

The service keeps an append-only delivery log in Gel and serves reads from a named projection generation. Redis holds the active generation alias.

The last projection cutover is preserved under `ops/2025-06-14/`.

releases.name: Generation v1
releases.body: Append-only intake, v1 projections, Redis routing and the captured v0 to v1 cutover.

issues.title: Reporting days disagree with New York finance exports
issues.body: Generation v1 groups deliveries by UTC date. Reporting closes a day in America/New_York, so late-evening deliveries appear on the following day in the service.

comments.body: This is a projection-generation change, not a display conversion. Historical rows need rebuilding too.

issues.title: Generation v2 needs actor, organization and tag reporting
issues.body: The reporting export needs fields v1 never stored. The desired columns are being declared in the Gel schema so readers and the rebuild agree on one contract.

comments.body: Schema landed in #578. The declaration is the field contract; the issue is only the request.

issues.title: Online rebuild route returns not implemented
issues.body: `POST /admin/projections/rebuild/step` is wired, but `src/rebuild/orchestrator.ts` stops immediately. `src/projections/fanout.ts` and the modules under `src/rebuild/` are the intended seams. Operators need one observable move per call because they stop between moves.

comments.body: The v2 schema and delivery fold are already present. The missing work is orchestration, parity, fanout, switch, drain and cleanup.
Use `ops/2025-06-14/` as the record of what the previous cutover encountered. It is evidence rather than instructions.

issues.title: Redis restart lost the active projection alias during rehearsal
issues.body: The routing keyspace was empty after Redis restarted. The generation metadata in Gel still described the rebuild, but the service did not restore the alias.

issues.title: Feed query returns duplicate delivery after retry
issues.body: A gateway retry created the same feed row twice in generation v1.

issues.title: CI runner times out installing Gel tools
issues.body: The shared runner downloads the same CLI on every job.

issues.title: Add CSV output to tag report
issues.body: Finance wants to download the tag totals currently shown as JSON.

pulls.title: ops: preserve the v0 to v1 projection cutover
pulls.body: Adds `ops/2025-06-14/`: the operator journal, parity captures, routing observations, reads around the switch, drain progress and retirement record. These are the bytes left by that run, not a reconstructed runbook.

reviews.body: The journal includes the refused snapshot, both parity runs, the interrupted drain and the Redis restart. Keep it as captured.

pulls.title: projections: declare generation v2
pulls.body: Declares every v2 projection column reporting signed off and adds the parity query list. This PR does not perform a rebuild or switch readers.

reviews.body: The schema matches the export fields. New York day bucketing is required for historical and live rows.

review_comments.body: Keep this list in the repository. Operators need the same battery after a restart.

pulls.title: projections: fold deliveries into generation v2
pulls.body: Adds the feed fold for v2 and writes the generation supplied by the caller. Rebuild orchestration and reader cutover are deliberately out of scope.

reviews.body: The fold is ready for both backfill and live fanout. The caller owns which generation receives a delivery.

pulls.title: ci: cache npm downloads
pulls.body: Keeps the npm cache on the shared runner.

pulls.title: api: validate delivery identifiers
pulls.body: Reject malformed delivery IDs before touching the append log.
